title.zh: 授予 Pablo R. Halili 在新怡诗夏省 Cabiao 市镇经营电灯、热力与动力系统的特许权法案
title.en: An Act Granting Pablo R. Halili a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Cabiao, Province of Nueva Ecija
title.orig: An Act Granting Pablo R. Halili a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Cabiao, Province of Nueva Ecija
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp quyền khai thác cho Pablo R. Halili để xây dựng, lắp đặt, vận hành và duy trì hệ thống điện tại thị xã Cabiao, tỉnh Nueva Ecija
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่ Pablo R. Halili เพื่อก่อสร้าง ติดตั้ง ดำเนินการ และบำรุงรักษาระบบไฟฟ้าในเทศบาล Cabiao, จังหวัด Nueva Ecija
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan waralaba kepada Pablo R. Halili untuk membangun, memasang, mengoperasikan, dan memelihara sistem tenaga listrik di Kotamadya Cabiao, Provinsi Nueva Ecija
title.ms: Akta memberikan francais kepada Pablo R. Halili untuk membina, memasang, mengendalikan dan menyelenggara sistem tenaga elektrik di Perbandaran Cabiao, Wilayah Nueva Ecija

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_4135_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the provisions of the Constitution and the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred thirty-six, as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred thirty-two, there is granted to Pablo R. Halili for a period of twenty-five years from the date of approval of this Act, the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate an electric light, heat and power system for the purpose of generating and/or distributing electric light, heat and/or power for sale within the Municipality of Cabiao, Province of Nueva Ecija. The grantee shall further have the right and privilege to install, lay and maintain on all streets, public thoroughfares, bridges and public places within said limits, poles, wires, transformers, capacitors, overhead protective devices, and pole line hardware, and other equipment necessary for the safe distribution of electric current to the public.

In the event that the National Power Corporation shall have established its lines in the areas adjacent to or over the territory covered by this franchise, the National Power Corporation may make available its power and heat only after negotiation with and through or with the authority and consent of the grantee.
The rates for the sale of electric light, heat and/or power shall always be subject to regulation by the Public Service Commission.
Upon approval of this Act, the municipal franchise granted to Pablo R. Halili shall terminate and this franchise shall take its place.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1964.
